subject: gk
question:
Which of the following pair of sports persons - sports associated with is correct?

I. Shefali Verma - Cricket

II. Sushil Kumar - Wrestling
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Yes, the pair of sports people and their associated sports are correct: Shefali Verma is a cricketer and Sushil Kumar is a wrestler: 
 
• Shefali Verma
 
 
• An Indian cricketer who plays for the women's national cricket team, Delhi Capitals, and India women's national under-19 cricket team.
 
• She became the youngest cricketer to play in a Women's Twenty20 International match for India in 2019 at the age of 15.
 
• She also became the youngest player to represent India in all three formats of international cricket in June 2021. 
 
 
 
• Sushil Kumar
 
 
• A former Indian wrestler and two-time Olympic medalist.
 
• He won an Olympic medal in 2008 in the Men's Freestyle Lightweight event and in 2012 in the Men's freestyle 66 kg event.
 
• He also won a medal at the 2018 Commonwealth Games in the Men's freestyle 74 kg event.
